title: Comment overclaims: rejection label can still draw at (12, 76) when the cursor is near the legend
evidence:
// construction (valid vs invalid) — so it never collides with the
// strain-legend row at (12, 76).
if app.drag.active && app.drag_to != 0 {
	cur := rnd.to_screen(&app.view, app.drag.wx, app.drag.wy)
	draw_text(app, reject_label(app.drag.valid), i32(cur.x)+12, i32(cur.y)-14, 16, rl.Color{200, 60, 60, 255})
...
draw_text(app, lead_s, 12, 76, 14, p.ink_soft)
...
wx, wy := rnd.from_screen(&app.view, f32(mx), f32(my))
app.drag.wx = wx
app.drag.wy = wy
detail: The label anchors at the unclamped mouse position + (12,-14); mouse at screen (0,90) during an invalid drag draws it exactly at (12,76), the legend's anchor. The fixed collision is gone, but "never collides" is false.
recommended_fix: Soften the comment: the rejection no longer draws at the FIXED (12, 76); a cursor dragged over the legend region can still transiently overlap it. Drop the "never collides" clause.
